reference.title: Document information
reference.shortdesc: Independent guides by Karan Deshmukh, written for Keycloak 26.8.2 and checked against a Keycloak 26.8.2 server running on his own computer, with a test realm and test users. Keycloak is an open-source project; these guides aren’t official Keycloak documentation, and nobody at the project reviewed them.
